entry.title: New: pdf-background-gray-codex-skill#dsh-pdf-background-gray
entry.summary: Registers the remove-pdf-background-gray skill for DSH: whitens gray/off-white scan backgrounds in image-based PDFs while preserving resolution, page geometry, and anti-aliased text edges (lossless Flate write-back), via a single Python script (pypdf + Pillow + numpy). Exact install spec: dsh-pdf-background-gray. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
